items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Well, George started coming in the eye of the public around, I'd say around 22.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was, he was about to next to me. He was George Lewis. When did George Lewis start coming in the public eye, would you say?

Well, George started coming in the eye of the public around, I'd say around 22. Mm-hmm. In 1922. Because we was playing at, uh, at, uh, Humming Booth, at, uh, Elite. And when we'd get through there, I had a place back, Iberville Street, that, Iberville and Mariette called, uh, the Boothwa. Uh, all the musicians used to go back there when they get off on wake. All of them used to go back there to jam. Jam that is six, seven o'clock the next morning. Well, George was playing a lot of clarinet then. So I'd say he…
And was his style similar to his today or different?
